integrity: The primary source date and MSC classification were verified from the arXiv record. The source's preorder-extension definition, finite-stabilization iteration, and cofinite-additive-submonoid example were checked in the full primary text. The pseudo-Frobenius definition and preservation under adjoining pseudo-Frobenius numbers were checked in an open-access numerical-semigroup source. The equality is proved directly by calculating strict upper cones; no experiment substitutes for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact closure identity is for the translation-invariant numerical-semigroup representatives P_H, not arbitrary finite perturbations that are merely almost equal to them. The pseudo-Frobenius saturation here is distinct from MED closure and its Apery-saturation algorithms. The universal genus bound is not claimed optimal as a function of genus alone.
title: Jagiella's preorder closure is pseudo-Frobenius saturation on numerical-semigroup orders
